$Comment: The shared body of the mastery point ladder: one Mastery Point every 15 levels of every skill,
from 15 to 195, waiting in the achievement book until the player collects it.
Each Mastery_Point_<level> file beside this one takes everything here through Parent and sets
only its own level (Criteria Amount), its rung on the {skill}_mastery_points ladder, its place
in the list and the id pattern its copies get. Each of those files is stamped out once for every
skill the server runs, the built-in ones and any a content pack adds, with {skill} standing for
the skill's id, so Mastery_Point_30 becomes mining_mastery_30, woodcutting_mastery_30, and so on.
Abstract is set because this file is only a body to inherit from: it has no level of its own,
so it is never listed or earned. Abstract does not carry down through Parent, which is why
every rung sets it again on itself.
A player already past a rung's level is offered it the next time they log in or open the book.
Requires hides the whole ladder when the server switches the mastery feature off.
To change what a rung pays, override this file (or one rung) by filename in a later pack and
edit Rewards. Keep the stamped ids: a player's progress is filed under them.
Name: Mastery_Point_Base
